title: Decree
about: A proclamation on heavy paper inside a ruled border, headed with its title in black letter and closed with a red wax seal.

fields.prop_issuer: Who proclaims it, printed above the heading, e.g. The Council of Aldmere
fields.prop_seal: The words pressed into the wax seal on the last sheet, e.g. SEAL OF THE COUNCIL; no seal when left out
